Chapter 703: Chapter 10 The First Type of Second Realm Fusion Rules (Please Subscribe)

Black planet.

Life and Death Samsara Rule Guiding Space.

The cycle of life and death rules seemed endless, as if without a conclusion.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, immersed in the comprehension, in comparison to directly fathoming the cosmic life and death rules.

At this moment, the life and death rules continually intertwined and fused before him, giving Lin Yuan the impression of watching a ‘standard answer.’

Every moment, his understanding of the Life and Death Samsara Rule was improving.

...

“The life rule, filled with endless vitality, and the death rule, permeated with boundless death energy, their fusion creates the Life and Death Samsara Rule, which essentially emphasizes the concept of ‘reincarnation.'”

Lin Yuan lifted his right hand, and the same life and death rules intertwined and fused in his palm.

“Therefore, the Life and Death Samsara Rule needs to construct a stable cycle model, so that the life and death rules can freely transform and interweave.”

Lin Yuan attempted to analyze the Life and Death Samsara Rule using the Human Civilization Rule Model approach.

Even the most basic Five Elements Rule is interpreted differently by thousands of people; the Fusion Rules are even more so, with the slightest discrepancy between the two rules involved causing divergence in the final formed Fusion Rule.

“A stable, perfect cycle model!”

In front of Lin Yuan, the life and death rules kept altering, eventually forming an ‘infrastructure’ resembling a dark vortex, subtly starting to influence time and space.

Unaffected, Lin Yuan continued to delve deeper into his comprehension.

[Your comprehension is extraordinary, observing the fusion of life and death, and deriving the first stable cycle model…]

…

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, a thunderous noise in his mind, as the Life and Death Samsara Rule advanced to the Second Realm.

“Finally cultivated this Fusion Rule to the Second Realm.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

The comprehension of the Fusion Rules was much harder than imagined, especially the transition from the First to the Second Realm.

Who knows how many Tenth-Rank Grade A individuals dragged on to the life limit of Tenth-Rank Life without crossing the threshold.

The previous Nalan, the Black Star Lord, and Master Lustrous were all like this.

Although the latter is said to have a chance to step into the Eleventh Rank, it is just a possibility, and it’s more likely they won’t cross it.

Even Lin Yuan, upon initially comprehending the Life and Death Samsara Rule and feeling the vast breath of life and death, thought it would take him five to six hundred years to cultivate this Fusion Rule to the Second Realm.

But now.

Merely fifty years had passed.

And he had already cultivated it to the Second Realm.

Theoretically, Lin Yuan can now use the Second Realm’s Life and Death Samsara Rule to break through to the Tier 11 level.

…

“The Life and Death Samsara Rule… At the level of the Second Realm, combined with the foundation of my Physical Soul’s Inner World, Spirit Will, Mysterious Yellow Strike, among others.”

“The ultimate power burst forth might reach the peak of the Third Realm, or even approach the power of the Fourth Realm’s Life and Death Samsara Rule?”

Lin Yuan wondered to himself.

When he initially grasped the Life and Death Samsara Rule, Lin Yuan, with the support of his many foundations, forcibly enhanced the Samsara Rule from the primary stage of the First Realm to the Second Realm and even touched the threshold of the Third Realm.

Now, with his understanding of the Life and Death Samsara Rule reaching the Second Realm, Lin Yuan felt his standard maximum attack should be close to the Fourth Realm.

It should be known that the Pillar-level Fusion Rules of the Fourth Realm, even among Eleventh-Rank Life forms, are considered quite powerful. Theoretically, the Fusion Rules of the Seventh and Eighth Realms are the domain of the Supreme Beings.

Of course, the abilities of Eleventh-Rank Life are far from limited to the Fusion Rules. However, this at least indicates that in one aspect, Lin Yuan has reached the normal standard of Eleventh-Rank Life.

He was no longer awkwardly at the threshold.

…

“The Second Realm’s Life and Death Samsara Rule…” Lin Yuan operated the already ‘established’ cycle model, attempting to affect the surrounding balance of life and death.

Boom!

Within the Guiding Space.

Massive life and death rules continuously intertwined and coiled, and the shadow of a stable, colossal cycle model began to emerge.

However.

Under the influence of Lin Yuan’s constructed minor cycle model, a trivial part of the Guiding Space’s major cycle model began to show faint turbulences.

But they quickly returned to normal.

Lin Yuan wasn’t surprised by this.

Inside the Guiding Space, the Life and Death Samsara Rule large model symbolizes the Fourth Realm’s Samsara Rule.

He was currently only at the Second Realm, so it was naturally difficult to cause an impact.

His attempt was merely to gauge how far he was from the Fourth Realm.

…

Outside the Guiding Space.

The black-robed man’s figure suddenly appeared.

“Hmm?”

“The balance of life and death within the space is being affected by an external force?”

The black-robed man’s expression changed slightly. As the spirit of the altar and the spirit of the black planet, he was acutely aware of all the changes inside the Guiding Space.

“The balance of life and death within the Life and Death Samsara Rule Guiding Space can only be affected by those who also wield Life and Death Samsara Rules. Has that young fellow cultivated his Life and Death Samsara Rule to the Second Realm?”

The black-robed man immediately surmised the cause.

“Second Realm?”

“How long has it been?”

The black-robed man was dumbfounded.

He didn’t consider the Second Realm’s Life and Death Samsara Rule that impressive, as it was just the threshold standard for Eleventh-Rank Life.

Yet what shocked the black-robed man was that fifty years ago, Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Life and Death Samsara Rule was only at an introductory level.

And now, only fifty years had passed, and it had soared to the Second Realm?

“There has been no change in the flow of time.” The black-robed man confirmed that Lin Yuan’s comprehension time did not deviate from the main time flow.

“With only the Guiding Space, there couldn’t possibly be such a significant effect.” The black-robed man’s expression grew serious.
